notes: The italic 'as' (t006) is given to the predicate nominal sar, which stands with no preposition and no object marker on it and is what the supplied word demotes to a role phrase; rule 16 says in its own terms that rule 33 governs this clause written without a marker (`יָבִיא קָרְבָּנוֹ` → *as his oblation*). The competing reading marks it added, and the ASV italic corroborates neither side by rule 7.

'am' is read as the auxiliary of the archaic perfect 'am ... come' rather than as a copula for the nominal clause, which is why the explicit pronoun s005 keeps only its 'I' under rule 17's explicit-subject sentence.
The directive he s018 takes its own 'to' as a separate unit (rule 32), the noun keeping 'the earth'.
